name: Maryland

office.name: MDOT SHA Motor Carrier Division - Hauling Permits Unit (Maryland One)

fees.note: COMAR 11.04.01.08C(1)(a): $30 base special hauling permit fee covering the first 40 tons of gross weight. Single trip one way, valid 5 days; extension $5.
COMAR 11.04.01.08C(1)(b): $5 per ton or part of a ton over 40 tons (80,000 lb). Confirmed against the current regulation (40 tons); SHA's older fee sheet showed 45 tons.

police.text: 1 police escort. Off-duty Maryland State Police; cost set by SHA schedule (manual 2008 listed $250). Notify MSP 48 hours ahead.
1 police escort. 75 tons or more. SHA may also require police for 65-75 tons, traffic diversion, or multi-lane occupancy.

restrictions.text: SHA: day moves 9:00 a.m.-3:30 p.m., night moves 8:00 p.m.-6:00 a.m.; loads up to 200,000 lb GVW, 13'11" wide, 14'6" high and 120' long may move 24/7 per permit. No travel on New Year's Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day. Exact hours are printed on the permit.
14 ft wide or more: travel 9:00 a.m.-3:30 p.m. only, on any highway.
12 ft+ wide (also 100 ft+ long or over 45 tons): Capital Beltway (I-495/I-95) and Baltimore Beltway (I-695) only 9:00 a.m.-3:30 p.m.
100 ft+ long: Capital Beltway (I-495/I-95) and Baltimore Beltway (I-695) only 9:00 a.m.-3:30 p.m.
Over 45 tons: Beltways 9:00 a.m.-3:30 p.m. only; speed at least 10 mph under the posted limit.

MdTA toll facilities (incl. I-95 JFK Hwy north of Fort McHenry Tunnel): permit moves only 9 a.m. Monday to 12 noon Friday, call facility 1 hour ahead. Fort McHenry Tunnel bans > 14'6" high or > 11' wide; Baltimore Harbor Tunnel (I-895) bans > 8' wide or > 13'6" high.

travel.note: Up to 13'11" wide, 14'6" high, 120' long and 200,000 lb may move around the clock. Good Friday is also closed (not modeled).

notes: COMAR 11.04.02.06 (base rule, stricter than current SHA web guidance): daylight 1/2 hr after sunrise to 1/2 hr before sunset, no Saturday after noon, no Sunday, no listed holiday periods - unless the permit sets other hours. Verify which hours SHA prints on current permits.
Fee basis conflict: COMAR 11.04.01.08 (chapter revised 2010) charges $5/ton over 40 tons; SHA fee sheet permit_fees.pdf charges $30 up to 45 tons then $5/ton. Calculator follows COMAR.

Other possible charges not modeled: SHA district monitoring $200/day when required; off-duty MSP escort per SHA schedule; MdTA and Baltimore City fees collected on the permit; engineering structural review $8/structure for > 60 tons per COMAR (SHA reported in 2016 that automated Maryland One permits eliminated bridge review fees).
Escort position: single escort modeled rear on interstate, front on non-interstate. Construction equipment over 12 ft wide off the Interstate also needs 1 escort (not modeled).
Excessive size (>= 16' high/wide or >= 100' long) needs application 2 working days ahead; > 60 tons needs 10 business days; > 250 tons 30 business days; bonds may be required.
Francis Scott Key Bridge (I-695) closed - permits using it must be rerouted (SHA notice).
SHA permits cover state roads; Baltimore City and county/local roads need their own approvals.
